def find_run_starts_with_status(grid, input_grid, output_grid):
    """Returns list of (row, col_start, value, length, status)"""
    runs = []
    num_rows = len(grid)
    num_cols = len(grid[0])
    
    for r in range(num_rows):
        c = 0
        while c < num_cols:
            val = grid[r][c]
            run_len = 1
            c += 1
            while c < num_cols and grid[r][c] == val:
                run_len += 1
                c += 1
            
            # Check if any cell in this run is changed
            changed = False
            for k in range(run_len):
                if grid[r][c - run_len + k] != output_grid[r][c - run_len + k]:
                    changed = True
                    break
            
            status = "REPLACED" if changed else "UNCHANGED"
            runs.append((r, c - run_len, val, run_len, status))
    
    return runs
